name: Carrington Mortgage Services, LLC
notes: Moved from the kubra family to loan-servicer: the catalog routed it to kubra from its processor field, but Carrington's web/app payments are powered by Speedpay inside its own servicing account (no KUBRA page). Researched from public carringtonmortgage.com pages only. Login: Username + Password, SIGN IN, "Forgot Username or Password?", "Register your Carrington loan". Payment Options: AutoPay (enroll after login on the AutoPay page), web/mobile app payments powered by Speedpay, automated Pay-by-Phone 1-800-561-4567 or a representative, bank bill pay, check (P.O. Box 660586 Dallas), Western Union (code city CARRINGTONMS, state CA), MoneyGram receive code 7998. Schedule of Fees: AutoPay, check, online (Speedpay), automated phone and representative payments are all free; late fee 5% of principal and interest or as the note/state allows (help only, not modelled); NSF $7-$50 by state. AutoPay article: draft any date within the grace period, semi-monthly or bi-weekly options (not modelled), change the date online any time. Mortgage assistance requested through the "Mortgage Assistance Portal" in the online account; decision within 30 days of a complete application. Customer service 800-561-4567 M-F 8-9 ET. Valon Mortgage loans moved to Carrington (separate sign-in site).

autopay.note: Choose any draft date within your grace period; you can change it online at any time.

pay_by_phone.note: Automated Pay-by-Phone and payments with a representative are both free.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Log in to pay online or in the Carrington Mobile app (powered by Speedpay), or call 1-800-561-4567 for automated Pay-by-Phone or to pay with a representative. None of these carry a Carrington fee.

Mail checks to Carrington Mortgage Services, LLC, P.O. Box 660586, Dallas, TX 75266-0586. In person, pay at Western Union (code city CARRINGTONMS, state CA; applied the next business day) or MoneyGram (receive code 7998). Your own bank's bill pay may charge its own fee.

help.title: AutoPay options
paragraphs: Enroll on the AutoPay page after you log in. Mortgage payments are usually due on the 1st, but you can set your draft for any date within your grace period, or split it into semi-monthly or bi-weekly drafts.
To change your draft date, log in and update your payment settings at any time. AutoPay is free.

help.title: Fees and late charges
paragraphs: AutoPay, online, automated phone, representative and check payments are all free. A late fee of 5% of principal and interest (or as your note and state law allow) applies when a payment is not received within the grace period in your loan documents.
A returned or dishonored payment costs $7 to $50 depending on your state.

help.title: Mortgage assistance
paragraphs: Options can include a repayment plan, forbearance, a loan modification, a short sale or a deed-in-lieu of foreclosure, depending on your loan's investor or insurer.

The quickest way to apply is to log in and choose Mortgage Assistance Portal on the left menu. You can also mail the application to the Loss Mitigation Department. We acknowledge it within five business days and decide within 30 calendar days of a complete application.

extra.intent: A Carrington borrower wants to pay in cash at MoneyGram. Using the Carrington help pages, find the MoneyGram receive code. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
A borrower asks whether Carrington charges a fee to make a payment with a customer service representative. Using the Carrington help pages, answer. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: No, paying with a representative is free.
